dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Consistent, symmetrical narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Symmetrical expansion at the pectoral fins; lateral margins are otherwise smooth and devoid of distinct indentations or bulges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone; high median pixel intensity across the dorsal plane with subtle grey shading at the lateral peripheries.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, fine-grained grey speckling distributed across the posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; gradual gradient transitions between the primary white skin and the low-contrast greyish texture.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp, well-defined linear dorsal ridge is visible along the central axis of the posterior half of the body.
